# Strong Integrity Fix – by Sarhan Root

A Magisk module designed to enhance and stabilize Strong Integrity on supported Android devices.  
This module focuses on improving compatibility, bypassing detection methods, and ensuring better performance across systems.

---

## 📌 Features
- Improved Strong Integrity bypass engine  
- Better compatibility with latest Android security patches  
- Stability enhancements for rooted devices  
- Lightweight and optimized for performance  

---

## 🔧 Installation
1. Download the latest version from the Releases section  
2. Open Magisk → Modules  
3. Tap Install from storage  
4. Select the module ZIP  
5. Reboot your device  

---

## 🔄 Updates
The module supports automatic over-the-air updates via Magisk.  
No manual action needed — Magisk will notify you when a new version is available.

---

## 🛠 Developer
Sarhan Root  
Advanced Root Solutions & Android System Modifications

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

Use at your own risk.
